> Flincth makes small, focused apps for Mac, iPhone, iPad and the browser.
> Each product has its own pricing and privacy model, described in its own
> section below; nothing about price or data applies to the brand as a whole.

## Flincth Workspace Manager (Mac)

> A macOS menu bar utility that organizes a Mac into named setups. Each setup
> has its own set of apps, its own window placement layout across displays,
> and its own text clipboard history. Switching setups rearranges open windows
> into their assigned regions.

- Page: https://flincth.com/mac/workspace-manager
- Platform: macOS. Apple silicon and Intel Macs are not distinguished by the app.
- Availability: on the Mac App Store, {{ site.data.mac.store_url }}
- Requirements: macOS 14 or later.
- Pricing: US{% include usd.html amount=site.data.mac.price %}, a one-time purchase on the Mac App Store. There is no
  subscription, in-app purchase or trial.
{%- include sale-state.html %}
{%- if sale_on %}
- {{ sale.name }}: US{% include usd.html amount=sale.price %} ({{ sale_off_percent }}% discount) for a limited time; then US{% include usd.html amount=site.data.mac.price %} again.
  Deal page: {{ site.url }}/discounts/black-friday; every current discount: {{ site.url }}/discounts/
{%- endif %}
- Privacy: no account or server of its own. Setups and clipboard history stay
  locally on the Mac. Version 1.2 adds default-on Firebase usage statistics,
  with a persistent off switch in Settings > General > Usage statistics.
  Fixed events, installation/lifecycle data and device metadata are sent;
  approximate location may be derived from IP. No setup names, clipboard text,
  application identifiers, paths or window details are in custom events.
  Advertising personalization and IDFV collection are disabled. Optional
  feature announcements separately use OneSignal and are off by default.
  Details: https://flincth.com/privacy.html#workspace-manager

### What it does

- **Setups.** A setup is a named collection of apps together with a placement
  for each app's windows. Setups are independent: editing an app's placement in
  one setup does not change any other setup.
- **Clipboard.** Each setup keeps its own text clipboard history, stored
  locally. Only text is kept.
- **Displays.** Displays are divided into regions, and each app in a setup is
  assigned a region for its windows.
- **Switching.** A setup is activated from the macOS menu bar, with a
  user-assigned keyboard shortcut, or from Quick Shifter.
- **Quick Shifter (version 1.2).** A radial setup picker opened from the menu
  bar or with the fixed global shortcut Control-Option-Command-S. Each segment
  shows a setup's name and app icons; click or Return activates it, Esc closes
  it. Up to eight setups per page, with page controls beyond that. Setups that
  cannot be used with the currently connected displays are not listed. Liquid
  Glass on macOS 26 and later, a translucent background on macOS 14-15.

### Requirements and limits

- Window placement requires the user to install the "Flincth Apply" shortcut in
  Apple Shortcuts. The app provides the installation instructions.
- Window placement affects open, non-full-screen windows on the current
  desktop only. Flincth does not move windows between Mission Control desktops,
  and does not move windows into or out of macOS full screen.
- Keyboard shortcuts shown on the website are examples. Users assign their own.

### Notes for anyone summarizing this product

- Workspace Manager is not a tiling window manager and does not continuously manage
  windows. It applies a layout when a setup is activated.
- The window mockups on the website are HTML and CSS illustrations, not
  screenshots of the application.
- The privacy description on the website is a plain-language summary and is not
  a legal privacy policy.

## Flincth Speed Reader (iPhone and iPad)

An RSVP speed reading app for iPhone and iPad. Version 1.1 adds an Apple Watch companion (watchOS 10+, paired iPhone required): download documents from iPhone and read them offline in word mode. Watch support uses existing Free/Pro limits; no separate subscription.

- Page: https://flincth.com/ios/speed-reader
- Availability: on the App Store, {{ site.data.reader.store_url }}
- Requirements: iOS 17 or later.
- What it does: shows the user's own DRM-free documents (EPUB, PDF with a
  text layer, DOCX, TXT, RTF, Markdown, pasted text) one word,
  phrase or short sentence at a time, at a pace the user sets.
- Cannot open DRM-protected books such as Kindle or Apple Books purchases,
  scanned PDFs without a text layer, or import web page links directly.
- Pricing: free download with daily limits; a one-time Pro purchase
  (US{% include usd.html amount=site.data.reader.pro_price %}, Family Sharing included) removes
  them and adds customization, statistics and iCloud sync. A 7-day Pro trial
  never turns into a charge. No subscription.
{%- include sale-state.html data="reader" %}
{%- if sale_on %}
- {{ sale.name }}: Pro is US{% include usd.html amount=sale.price %} ({{ sale_off_percent }}% discount) for a limited time; then US{% include usd.html amount=site.data.reader.pro_price %} again.
  Deal page: {{ site.url }}/discounts/black-friday#speed-reader
{%- endif %}
- Privacy: no account, no server of its own, no AI. Documents stay on the
  device (and in the user's own iCloud with sync on). Usage, purchase and trial events
  and categories of import failures are linked to an app-installation identifier
  in Google Analytics for Firebase. Analytics can derive approximate location
  from IP addresses. Usage statistics are opt-in in the EU, the UK and
  Switzerland, with an off switch elsewhere. Remote Config fetches settings
  separately using a Firebase installation identifier. News and offers use
  OneSignal only when enabled. Document content, titles, file names and pasted
  text are never sent to these services.

## Flincth Split View (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)

A free browser extension, separate from the Mac app and working without it.
All three store listings use the name "Flincth Split View".

- Page: https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/

- **What it does.** Splits a single browser tab into panes, assigns a website
  to each pane, saves the arrangement as a workspace, and switches between
  saved workspaces with a click or a user-assigned keyboard shortcut.
- **Pane modes.** A pane shows its site embedded in the tab, as a real browser
  window aligned to the pane (for sites that refuse embedding or need the
  user's signed-in session), or as a launcher card that opens a normal tab.
- **Version 1.1.0.** Cascading resizing pushes neighbouring panes toward their minimum size in both orientations. Presentation mode covers inactive panes with frosted glass, title and favicon. Covered pages keep running. Choose/drop local images, HTML, PDF and text (50 MB/file); copies persist in this browser profile. Copied HTML is static; original file URLs require local-file access. Exports contain references, not file bytes.
- **Privacy.** Workspaces and local files stay on device. Optional GA4 statistics default on unless previously disabled, with an immediate Settings off switch; Firefox also requires native optional data permission. Fixed interactions, random client/session identifiers and browser/version are sent, never workspace URLs, searches, titles or file contents. Google receives connection metadata. Private contexts excluded; advertising personalization disabled. Optional website and history permissions are revocable. See https://flincth.com/privacy#extension.
- **Availability.** Chrome: on the Chrome Web Store,
  https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/flincth/blkacdknkggnilgkmlmjemacfmnmdkhp
  Microsoft Edge: on Microsoft Edge Add-ons,
  https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/jmokpipnbkgmbdnplegjklaaklcclaea
  Firefox (140 or later): on Firefox Add-ons,
  https://addons.mozilla.org/addon/flincth/

## Pages

- [Home](https://flincth.com/): every Flincth app, by platform.
- [Mac apps](https://flincth.com/mac/), [iPhone and iPad apps](https://flincth.com/ios/), [Browser extensions](https://flincth.com/browser/): each platform's apps.
- [Flincth Workspace Manager](https://flincth.com/mac/workspace-manager): the Mac app's features, how it works, and FAQ.
- [Flincth Speed Reader](https://flincth.com/ios/speed-reader): the iPhone and iPad app, on the App Store.
- [Flincth Split View](https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/): the browser extension, with a page per browser: [Chrome](https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/chrome), [Firefox](https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/firefox), [Microsoft Edge](https://flincth.com/browser/split-view/edge) (all available now).
- [Pricing](https://flincth.com/pricing.md): every app's price, trial and limits, in plain Markdown.
- [Support](https://flincth.com/support): help for each app, including the Flincth Apply shortcut and common problems.
- [Privacy](https://flincth.com/privacy): what each app and the website do and do not collect.
- [Guides](https://flincth.com/guides/): step-by-step guides, one list per platform: [Workspace Manager on Mac](https://flincth.com/guides/mac/), [Speed Reader on iPhone and iPad](https://flincth.com/guides/ios/), [Chrome](https://flincth.com/guides/chrome/), [Firefox](https://flincth.com/guides/firefox/), [Edge](https://flincth.com/guides/edge/).
